items.html: Now, if you add the five Gevurot of Ima mentioned above, called Mantzapach, which correct the aforementioned 315 [sparks], they all together make 320 sparks. For the five Gevurot of Mantzapach are also called sparks, since they too are Gevurot and judgments. And corresponding to them are 320 sparks in the Nukva. Then ZA is called Naar, which equals 320 in gematria; and the Nukva too is called Naar lacking a Hey, which is likewise her 320.
